setup.intro: Home Assistant isn't connected yet. To set it up:

steps.install: Install Home Assistant on the LAN (e.g. on this server) and finish its onboarding at http://192.168.1.10:8123.
steps.integrations: In Home Assistant, add the integrations: Verisure (alarm), DSMR Smart Meter or HomeWizard Energy (P1 port of the digital meter), your inverter (solar), and smart plugs for the washer and dryer.
steps.energy: Set up the Energy dashboard in Home Assistant (grid import and export per tariff, solar, battery, gas, individual devices).
steps.token: Create a token: Home Assistant → your profile (bottom left) → Security → Long-lived access tokens → Create token. Copy it once; it isn't shown again.
steps.env: On the server, add to /var/www/WickedHome/.env: HOME_ASSISTANT_URL=http://192.168.1.10:8123 and HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN=… (the token stays on the server).
steps.restart: Restart the app (pm2 restart wickedhome). This card then shows Connected, and the energy import starts by itself.
